The <b>{{lc:{{PAGENAME}}}}</b> is a food item which restores {{Energy|+|15}} when consumed. Since the items which can be used to craft {{lc:{{PAGENAME}}}}s lack quality levels it can not be improved by using higher quality ingredients. For more information on preparing food see [[cooking]]. {{PAGENAME}}s can also be purchased from [[Horadric]] in [[The Dead Horse]].

The recipe can be unlocked by asking the farmer "What can you tell me about farming?"
